text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired — PD#12345 — Service: inference-eu-prod — symptom: elevated 5xx rate (avg 18% over 2m). Auto-ack was deferred due to a silent window. Incident link: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345
incident-bot: New incident created and linked: INC-2026-0456. Severity: P1. Paging escalation policy: inference-oncall.
alice: I’m taking this. Oncall shift here, will start triage. :hand:
raj: thx alice — do you want the eu pool to be cordoned while we look?
alice: yes please. sam can you run cordon on eu-inference-nodes-1?
sam: running now — kubectl cordon node/gpu-eu-01 && kubectl drain node/gpu-eu-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
sam: drain started, ETA ~45s. logs show eviction progressing.
devon: copying commands from autopilot to reroute traffic for warmup: 

# redirect new requests away from eu-superpool
curl -X POST https://internal-router/route -d '{"service":"inference-eu","weight":0.2}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN"

alice: good. emily, can you pull the last 5k lines from the inference-edge logs for 10.0.5.0/24? suspecting a model crash loop causing 502s.
emily: grabbing logs: `kubectl logs -n inference svc/inference-edge --since=15m --tail=5000 | grep -i error` — found repeated "kv cache eviction failed" and OOMKilled on model-worker-7.
raj: OOMKilled on model-worker-7 matches the throughput spike earlier. Are we running the new quantization branch on eu?
emily: yes, the canary was at 30% in eu; config shows q8 remodel applied 02:10 UTC.
alice: rollback canary to stable for eu. sam can you route canary off and redeploy stable on those pods?
sam: initiating rollback: `kubectl set image deployment/inference-worker inference-worker=redwood/inference:stable-1.12.3 --namespace=inference` — rolling update in progress.
incident-bot: Status update requested by alice. Current: owner=alice, mitigation=rollback canary, cordoning nodes, draining in-progress, customer-impact=high (elevated errors).
alice: I’ve notified support to pause marketing pushes. Notifying top 5 customers now.
raj: any quick workaround to reduce memory pressure while rolling? maybe reduce max_batch_size to 4 on the service config?
devon: yes you can patch configmap to override batch size until stable completes:

kubectl patch configmap inference-config -n inference --type json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/max_batch_size","value":"4"}]'

emily: applied batch_size=4. Memory metrics show immediate decline in RSS on model-worker replicas.
alice: good. sam, how many pods have been updated to stable?
sam: 4/8 updated, 2 still terminating from drain, rollout progressing OK.
raj: paging note — PD escalation window set to 5m. If ack stays, PD will escalate to secondary. alice — will you keep ownership or hand to raj after initial mitigation?
alice: I’ll keep until rollback finishes and error rate back to <1% for 10m. After that I’ll hand to raj for post-incident analysis.
incident-bot: Next automated check at +5m. Current metrics snapshot: 5xx rate 9% (down from 18%), avg latency +40ms.
emily: customer impact: Support ticket aggregator shows 12 open high-sev chats in last 10m. I sent PRD update to SRE-liaison.
raj: noted. Alice — can you paste the exact rollback command you used so on-call can reproduce in other regions if needed?
alice: rollback command (used): `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-worker --to-revision=stable-1.12.3 -n inference` — followed by `kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-worker -n inference`
sam: rollout now at 7/8 stable, pods healthy.
alice: ok once we hit 8/8 stable and 5xx < 1% I’ll close PD and create postmortem. For now keep on-call chatty.
devon: also toggled autoscaler to conservative mode to avoid spike-driven scaleouts: `kubectl scale --replicas=4 hpa/inference-worker -n inference`
incident-bot: Update: rollback completed. New snapshot: 5xx rate 0.6%, latency normalized. Owner=alice. Recommended next steps: post-incident notes, run grep across canary logs for root cause.
alice: marking progress: :white_check_mark: mitigation complete. I’ll hand off to raj for follow-up and postmortem. raj — you’re up for investigation.
raj: taking it. I’ll open an investigation doc and assign action items for quantization gating and canary rollout checks.
emily: customer comms queued — paraphrased: "We experienced transient elevated errors in EU affecting inference; rollback applied and service restored; investigating root cause; follow-up with detailed postmortem."
alice: thanks all. closing this thread in ~30m after we confirm no regression. :thumbsup:
pagerbot: PD#12345 auto-resolved (ack cleared) — incident resolved.
